items.title: Why the Dow Is Dropping but the S&P 500 Is at a Record High
items.summary: The Dow’s early gains have faded away, but the S&P 500 is up to its highest levels on record.  The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 90 points, or 0.2%, after rallying 200 points earlier in the morning.  The S&P 500 was up 0.4% and on pace for a record close.
